text: Standard parcels are delivered within 3 to 5 business days. Express parcels are delivered within 1 to 2 business days.
A parcel is considered delayed when its expected delivery date has passed. Customers should contact support after 2 additional business
days.
Customers can track parcels using their tracking number. Tracking information is updated when parcels reach scanning checkpoints.
Customers must report damaged parcels within 48 hours of delivery and provide photographs of the damaged package.
A parcel may be declared lost after 10 business days without tracking updates. Support must investigate before confirming loss.
Refunds for approved lost or damaged parcel claims are processed within 7 business days.
Couriers attempt delivery twice before returning the parcel to the local depot.
Delivery addresses may be changed before the parcel is dispatched. Address changes after dispatch are not guaranteed.
Customers may cancel a shipment before dispatch. Once dispatched, cancellation requests require support review.
Eligible parcels may be returned within 14 days of delivery, subject to the sender's return policy.
Proof of delivery may include a recipient signature, delivery photograph, or courier confirmation.
Customer complaints receive a reference number. Support aims to provide an initial response within 24 hours.
Severe weather may delay parcel delivery. Customers should check tracking updates for revised delivery estimates.
International parcels may be delayed by customs inspection. Customs clearance times vary by destination.
Hazardous materials, illegal goods, and other restricted items cannot be shipped through the parcel service.
Optional shipment insurance may cover eligible loss or damage up to the declared insured value.
Standard parcels must not exceed 25 kilograms. Oversized or overweight shipments require special handling.
Customers may schedule parcel pickup at least one business day in advance, subject to availability.
If delivery fails because the recipient is unavailable, the courier may leave instructions for redelivery.
Unresolved delivery complaints may be escalated to a supervisor after 48 hours without a satisfactory resolution.
